review_method: Two independent critics initially started with fresh context, then reviewed successive image iterations.
latest_user_constraints: Extend the far-right rock wall toward the camera
Terminate lower-platform railing against the wall

reviews.assessment: Platform positions, differing orientations, bridge connection and shared rock enclosure closely match the reference. Smaller turntable preserves floor margin. Extended right wall receives railing.
Stairs removed; railing terminates against forward wall; upper booth connects continuously to hangar balcony. Both openings remain readable and central platform preserved.
reviews.remaining_style_note: The broad separator rock remains more slab-like than the image reference, while retaining the approved pillar style.

final_changes_after_review: Two short railing end pieces were fitted to measured ray intersections with the rock wall; all other reviewed geometry is unchanged.

support_revision.assessment: Rock clearly meets all six brackets; triangular I-section supports, bearing plates and bolts read as an integrated system. Dedicated lower camera added to reveal foreshortened connections.
